s.n: Lakeside crumbed fish bites with tartare
s.note: Panko crumbed flathead bites with homemade tartare sauce
s.how: Cut 500g flathead fillets into 3cm pieces. Toss in 50g plain flour, dip in 2 beaten eggs, then coat in 120g panko crumbs. Shallow fry in oil at 180C for 2 minutes a side until golden, then drain. For the tartare, mix 150g mayonnaise with 1 tbsp chopped capers, 2 tbsp chopped dill pickles, 1 tbsp chopped parsley and a squeeze of lemon. Serve hot with the tartare and lemon wedges.

s.note: Wisconsin lake country, where Chet only wanted a quiet week
s.how: Squeaky cheese curds in a light crisp batter, fried golden and served hot with ranch. Whisk 150g plain flour, 1 tsp sweet paprika and 1 tsp salt with 1 egg and 250ml cold soda water. Dip 500g cheese curds or cubed mild cheddar in the batter and fry in batches at 180C for 1 to 2 minutes until golden. Drain and serve hot with 150ml ranch dressing.
shop: 500g cheese curds or mild cheddar, cubed@Dairy

m.note: Big rump steak with garlic butter, onion rings, roast potatoes, ranch wedge
m.how: Rub a 1.5kg piece of rump steak with oil and salt. Toss 1kg halved potatoes in oil and roast at 220C for 40 minutes. Grill the steak over high heat for 8 minutes a side for medium rare, then rest 10 minutes. Melt 60g butter with 2 crushed garlic cloves. Bake 400g frozen onion rings for 15 minutes. Cut 1 iceberg lettuce into wedges and drizzle with ranch. Slice the steak thickly, pour over the garlic butter and serve.

w.note: Blueberry pie with a lemon scented filling and pastry crust
w.how: Toss 750g frozen blueberries with 120g caster sugar, 3 tbsp cornflour and the zest and juice of 1 lemon. Line a 23cm pie dish with 1 sheet shortcrust pastry and fill with the berries. Cover with a second sheet, crimp the edges and cut 4 slits on top. Brush with 1 beaten egg and sprinkle with 1 tbsp sugar. Bake at 200C for 15 minutes, then 180C for 35 minutes until bubbling. Cool 30 minutes and serve with ice cream.

d.note: Root beer over vanilla ice cream with a cocktail cherry
d.how: Chill 4 large mugs or glasses in the freezer for 20 minutes. Add 2 scoops vanilla ice cream to each. Slowly pour cold root beer down the side until it foams to the top, letting it settle and topping up, about 300ml per mug. Add a cocktail cherry to each and serve straight away with straws and long spoons.

shopping: 500g cheese curds or mild cheddar, cubed@Dairy
